candidate: H71 whole-neuron W0 context with procedural local writes
causal_question: Does complete paired-neuron W0 context supply the nonlocal identity missing from H70 while a frozen full-rank local decoder avoids H70's learned-frame gauge and expresses every dominant and weak joint MLP trajectory direction under one percent persistent state?

controls.learned_local_decoder: replace the frozen seed-bound D_u and D_v with charged learned frames as a diagnostic of the H70 decoder gauge
controls.no_whole_neuron_context: zero the complete-neuron context while retaining and charging P and B
controls.shuffled_whole_neuron_context: deterministically permute contexts among paired neurons within each layer while preserving the context distribution
controls.w0_blind: replace the exact complete-neuron and local-block W0 inputs with deterministic seed-bound Gaussian pseudo-initialization of identical shape

fit.objective: uniform mean over layers and all top-16 PCs of independently normalized paired detector-plus-write block reconstruction error
fit.offline_pc_codes: one fitted 16-vector per measured layer and PC is an image-capacity nuisance coordinate and is not deployed state

forbidden: CE training or evaluation as a promotion criterion
hosts other than PRO6 without explicit user authorization
stored trajectory PCs, empirical ambient bases, dense shadows, W0 copies, per-row codes, or per-block codes
context-width, hidden-width, block-size, latent, decoder, activation, optimizer, objective, seed, layer, or horizon sweeps

inputs.residual_gauge: joint complete-neuron c_fc rows plus transposed c_proj rows, exact step-zero subtraction, uncentered displacement PCA

metrics: procedural D_u and D_v numerical ranks and singular-value condition
state bytes, static/refresh arithmetic, runtime, peak CUDA memory, and all hashes
promotion: Only a complete representation pass authorizes frozen-decoder chronological late-state and disjoint-stream A/B audits with fresh nuisance codes. It does not authorize CE, attention, another host, or scale-up.
rejection: Any required gate failure closes the exact whole-neuron-context/local-write H71 topology without a sweep and requires new theory before another transform.

FP32 masters, gradients, optimizer moments, and nuisance-code bytes
refresh wall time, total runtime, and peak CUDA allocation
